name: Nimrod (son of Cush)
title: The first mighty ruler
summary: Nimrod was the son of Cush and grandson of Ham. He was the first to become a mighty ruler on earth and was known as a mighty hunter before the Lord. He founded several great cities in Shinar and Assyria, including Babel and Nineveh.

keyEvents.title: The first mighty ruler
keyEvents.description: Nimrod was the first on earth to become a mighty man and began to be a powerful ruler.

keyEvents.title: A mighty hunter before the Lord
keyEvents.description: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord, which became a saying: 'Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the Lord.'

keyEvents.title: Founding of Babel
keyEvents.description: Nimrod established his kingdom with Babel as its capital, along with Erech, Akkad and Calneh in the land of Shinar.

keyEvents.title: Expansion to Assyria
keyEvents.description: From Shinar he went out to Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah and Resen, great cities in the Assyrian empire.

keyEvents.title: The land of Nimrod mentioned by the prophet Micah
keyEvents.description: The prophet Micah refers to Assyria as 'the land of Nimrod' in his prophecy about the Messiah and Israel's future.
